decisions.reason: The client explicitly preserves the established Hero V slope and structure; the terminal treatment is owned by the separate shared-terminal Requirement.
Selecting Balanced Flow kerning does not change the chosen Satin Reflection finish, gold distribution, or other material-treatment attributes.
The source does not change the second V's relative height, prominence, or relationship to the surrounding letters.
A complete same-message MODIFY already captures the cleaner architectural terminal, desired qualities, avoided flourish, consistency rule, and preserved geometry; no edit is required.
The source selects a spacing variation and revises the shared V/É terminal, but does not change the E or L letterform design language.
The common-baseline rule remains valid and is not modified by the selected kerning variation.
The terminal is to be refined consistently across the glyphs, but the exact Hero V–É accent peak-alignment rule is neither replaced nor relaxed.
The source does not change the E/L cap-height relationship to the second V's left arm.
The established second V structure is explicitly preserved; its shared terminal treatment is independently represented by REQ_SHARED_SIGNATURE_TERMINAL.
Consistent terminal refinement does not alter the rule that the É accent must be a literal one-to-one derivation from the Hero V terminal.
The source contains design feedback but does not change the obligation to include rationale with review rounds.
